evidence_snippets: Note: This feature is only available for Cloud SQL Enterprise Plus edition instances that are configured to meet Managed Connection Pooling requirements.
If you select MySQL 8.0 and MySQL 8.0.35 or later for the Minor version , then the Enable automatic minor version upgrade checkbox is automatically selected for your instance.
Managed Connection Pooling lets you scale your workloads by optimizing resource utilization and connection latency Cloud SQL instances using pooling and multiplexing.
